svg.desc: 1511 commits across five public projects, 69 active days, peak 169 commits per day. 2026-09-05 through 2026-11-27 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-27T15:19:42.951Z.
